source_note: The live EIG manifest reports 178 results for Savills on 25 March 2013. Its public, non-subscriber view exposes the first 100 item cards in order-of-sale order and then explicitly limits the remaining 78. Each exposed card is banked immediately with stable EIG lot ID and GUID, locality, result, description, income/yield text and image URL. Lot number and street address remain null because the public cards do not expose them. The separate original lot-102 PDF record preserves 109 Wendover House with its exact address.
